column2: Retain succession and Jehoshaphat's strengthening against Israel. The repeated personal name distinguishes the new king from his deceased father.
Retain the stationed force, appointed leaders and both Judah and the Ephraim cities previously taken by Asa. Do not collapse military and administrative actions into one.
Retain his father's earlier ways and the refusal to seek idols. The selected text does not name David here.
column3: Which ancestral figure father denotes should remain open; no name is supplied.

column2: Retain seeking his father's God and walking in his father's commandments, with the contrast to Israel's works. Do not silently turn the second father into God.
column3: The possessive chain and referent of the commandments require further review.

column2: Retain the Lord establishing the kingdom in his hand, all Judah's gifts and abundant wealth and glory. The human possession follows the explicitly divine establishing action.
Retain heart lifted in the Lord's way and further removal of high places and groves. This favorable context does not warrant rendering the heart image as sinful pride.
Retain year three, leaders and sons of mighty men, four listed names and their teaching mission. Do not import an additional Ben-hail from another textual form.
Retain eight named Levites, the repeated Levites label, and Elisama and Joram as priests. No extra Levite is added to harmonize another roster.
Retain the law book accompanying the teachers and both occurrences of teaching, first in Judah and then the people throughout its cities.
Retain terror from the Lord upon surrounding kingdoms and their not making war against Jehoshaphat. Earth is qualified by around Judah, not made an unqualified global claim.
Retain gifts, silver and offerings, followed by 7,700 rams of the flock from the Arabs. The selected text has no second goat total.
column3: The distinction between gifts and offerings and the ethnonym foreigners remain provisional lexical choices.

column2: Retain progressive growth, the height image, dwellings in Judea and fortified cities. Dwellings is not replaced with storehouses from a parallel version.
column3: Rising to a height remains a provisional calque requiring spoken-language review.

column2: Retain many works in Judea and powerful warriors in Jerusalem. Do not make the works military stores without lexical evidence.
Retain ancestral-house accounting, Judah's commanders, Ednas and 300,000 men. Mighty sons of strength preserves the layered expression without claiming idiomatic finality.
column3: The military expression needs a consistent readable rendering across these lists.

column2: Retain Joanan after Ednas and 280,000. After him marks list sequence without asserting a later historical command.
Retain Amasia son of Zachri, his eagerness for the Lord and 200,000 mighty men. The devotion is not rewritten as a formal vow.
Retain Benjamin, Eliada, 200,000 archers and light-shield bearers. The equipment distinction should not disappear into generic armed men.
Retain Jozabad, sequence after Eliada and 180,000 mighty in war. No extra tribal label is invented.
Retain service to the king apart from the separately stationed fortified-city forces throughout Judea. The list is not identified with all garrisons combined.
Retain still abundant wealth and glory and the marriage alliance specifically with Ahab's house. The alliance is not reduced to a personal friendship.

Retain the elapsed years, descent to Samaria, sacrificed sheep and calves for king and people, and Ahab's ongoing enticement to Ramoth. Enticing reflects the verb also used for deception later in the chapter.
Retain the two kings' titles and the reciprocal wording As I am, so are you, followed by your people/my people. Do not reverse these pronouns to match a familiar parallel.
Retain the appeal to seek the Lord today, with please for the exhortative particle. No explicit word of the Lord is added to the object.
Retain 400 prophets, the go-or-refrain alternatives and God giving into the king's hands. It supplies the unexpressed object contextually without naming a new army.
Retain the question about another prophet of the Lord and the plural inquiry. Another reflects the remaining/additional force in the question.
Retain one remaining man, hatred, prophecy concerning the king, all his days for evil and Michaias son of Iemla. Jehoshaphat's restrained objection remains ordinary human address.
column3: All his days are for evil remains a provisional expression whose relation to repeated prophecy needs clearer English review.

column2: Retain one eunuch and the elliptical urgent summons naming Michaias and his father. No additional narrative action is supplied as if expressly stated.
Retain each king's own throne, robes, the broad space at the doorway of Samaria's gate, and all prophets before them. The repeated sitting is preserved.
Retain Sedekias son of Chanana, self-made iron horns and the claim about goring Syria until completion. The divine quotation is a reported prophetic claim, not an editorial certification.
Retain the repeated common prophecy, ascent, prosperity and the Lord giving into the king's hands. The unnamed object remains a contextual it.
Retain behold, one mouth, favorable speech about the king and the messenger's request for matching words. The final future you shall speak is not silently changed to a new imperative.
Retain the oath by the living Lord and the commitment to speak whatever God says. The Lord/God distinction in the selected wording remains visible.

Retain the king's repeated alternatives and Michaias's ascent/prosperity answer with a plural they will be given. Your here represents a plural Greek possessive, unlike the preceding singular imperatives.
column3: The unnamed plural recipients and the ironic force are contextual; no stage direction or guessed enemy noun is inserted.

column2: Retain repeated adjuration, truth alone and the Lord's name. The restriction is explicit in the Greek and does not supply an unrelated only.
Retain scattered Israel, the mountains, shepherdless sheep, the Lord's no-leader declaration and each person's peaceful return home. Leader is not replaced with king merely to explain the image.
Retain the king's complaint and the exclusive contrast to evil. This is the king's interpretation of the prophecy, not narrator commentary.
Retain Not so, plural hearers, the enthroned Lord and all heaven's host on both sides. No in-front-of-Him clause is imported from Kings.
Retain the Lord's question about deceiving Ahab so he goes up and falls at Ramoth, and the differing replies. The divine initiative is neither removed nor expanded into a theological explanation.
Retain the definite spirit coming out, standing before the Lord and volunteering deception. The Lord's question asks the means; lowercase spirit leaves its identity unresolved.
column3: The spirit's identity and capitalization remain open rather than being identified as the Holy Spirit.

column2: Retain becoming a lying spirit in all prophets' mouths, the assurance of deception and ability, and the commands to go and act. The change of speaker in He said is contextual, not morphologically named.
Retain now/behold, the Lord putting the lying spirit in these prophets and speaking evil against Ahab. Do not soften the agency into mere human error.
Retain the blow on the jaw and Sedekias's challenge about the road by which the Lord's Spirit passed. The capitalization reflects the claimed divine relation without settling the truth of his claim.
Retain the future sight, that day and chamber from chamber for concealment. Do not replace the spatial expression with an assured technical inner-room designation.
column3: Chamber from chamber remains provisional and needs lexical and spoken-language review.

column2: Retain return to Emer the city ruler and Joash described as both ruler and king's son. The second ruler title is explicit and must not be omitted.

Retain the plural imprisonment command, bread and water of affliction and return in peace. The Greek shifts from plural take/return to singular you shall say; English you leaves that distinction implicit.
column3: Let him eat with water as a coordinated object remains awkward and provisional; deprivation, not a specific ration size, is expressed.

column2: Retain the emphatic return condition, the denial that the Lord spoke in the prophet and the summons to all peoples. In me is not automatically replaced with through me.
Retain both named kings ascending to Ramoth-galaad. No additional campaign chronology is supplied.
Retain covering himself, entry into battle and the instruction that Jehoshaphat wear my clothing. The selected possessive is not changed to your robes to harmonize a parallel.
Retain the Syrian king's restriction addressed to his chariot commanders: neither small nor great, only Israel's king. No commander count is imported.
Retain mistaken identification, encirclement, Jehoshaphat's cry, the Lord saving him and God turning the pursuers away. Both divine actions are explicit.
Retain recognition that he was not Israel's king and their turning away. The repeated retreat is not removed as redundant with the preceding divine explanation.
Retain accurate aim, the wound between lung and breastplate, the request to turn the charioteer's hand and the king's pain. Do not substitute at random or armor joints for the selected Greek.
column3: The anatomical and armor relationship and turn your hand remain provisional lexical questions.

column2: Retain the battle becoming a rout, the king standing in his chariot facing Syria until evening, and death at sunset. Do not substitute being propped up or a strengthened battle from another text.
